Summarize time-reallocation effects

Source: R/summary_realloc.R
summary.realloc.Rd

Tabulates the reallocations of a predict_realloc() result as a tidy tibble at full numeric precision: one row per receiving part, donor part and reallocation magnitude (delta), with the parts' display labels. Printing the result shows a text report, as with summary.lm(). pub_ready() builds the wide publication table from it, with the effect estimate and its confidence interval under a column spanner for each delta.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'realloc'
summary(object, labels = attr(object, "labels"), ...)

Arguments

object

A realloc object from predict_realloc(). An infeasible transfer (a row with NA estimates, the predict_realloc() default) is kept, and shows as - in the pub_ready() table.

labels

Optional named character vector mapping raw part names to display labels (e.g., c(MVPA = "Exercise", SB = "Sedentary")). Parts not named keep their raw names, and the implicit "all remaining parts" side of a one-to-all reallocation is shown as "All other parts". Defaults to the labels of the declare_composition() object behind the fit (if any); pass a vector here to override them.

...

Unused; present for S3 consistency. Passing display, digits, p_flag or conf_level is an error: rounding and the significance flag are set in pub_ready(), and the confidence level in predict_realloc().

Value

An object of class summary_realloc, printed as a text report by print.summary_realloc() and passed to pub_ready() for a gt table. A list with elements:

table

A tibble with one row per reallocation: to, from, the by grouping column and response_level when present, the display labels to_label and from_label, then delta, estimate, conf.low, conf.high and, for relative output, p.value. The reference row of an absolute prediction is dropped; a zero reallocation (delta = 0) is kept.

effect_label, type, conf_level, parts, by

Kept for print.summary_realloc() and pub_ready().

units

The composition's unit label, shown beside each delta in the pub_ready() table; NULL when none was declared.

See also

predict_realloc() to build the realloc object; plot_realloc() for the continuous sweep figure; pub_ready() for the publication gt table built from this summary.

Other reallocation and prediction: optimal_composition(), plot_realloc(), predict_realloc()

Examples

cd <- declare_composition(timeuse, c("MVPA", "LPA", "SB", "SPT"),
                          closure = 1440)
fit <- comp_iv(cd, outcome = "obesity", model = "glm", family = "binomial")
r <- predict_realloc(fit, delta = c(10, 20, 30), on_invalid = "na")
s <- summary(r, labels = c(MVPA = "Exercise"))
s$table
